name: Skull Bash
description: When you use this move, you lower your head and prepare to strike a target within range. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you charge at a creature in range, ignoring your walking speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. A creature hit with this attack must succeed on a {save} or be knocked prone.
